method: THREE.Box3 on production-order procedural models after userData.scale. X/Z are horizontal, Y is height. horizontalRadius encloses all horizontal corners relative to entity origin, including asymmetric gun/antenna offsets.
limitations: No GLB import or GPU: four replacement keys across three assets require parent actual imported-model checks. Bounds enclose present mesh geometry including thin antennae; not exact triangle intersection and not proof of visual authenticity. Animated barrel/rotor extremes require separate margins.
